fee_notes: Royalty is 5% of weekly Gross Sales, reduced by 1% for the first 12 months for qualifying franchisees who open within 9 months of signing. Marketing Fund Fee is currently 2% of weekly Gross Sales, can increase up to 3%. Local Marketing Requirement is an additional 1% of Gross Sales spent locally. Software Costs are currently $250-$500/month (pass-through to vendors). Technology Fee is not currently charged but reserved at up to $200/month (max $300/month if implemented). Late fee is 18% per year or maximum lawful rate. Insufficient Funds Fee is currently $150/occurrence (max $200).
raw_excerpt:
Royalty Fee(s): Five percent (5%) of weekly Gross Sales. Tuesday (for the Monday through Sunday of the preceding week). The Royalty Fee is withdrawn from your designated bank account by EFT. We reserve the right to adjust the payment frequency and/or measuring period but the amount payable shall not exceed 5% of Gross Sales. The royalty fee is reduced by 1% for the first 12 months for franchisees in good standing who open their locations within 9 months of signing the franchise agreement.

Marketing Fund Fee: Currently two percent (2%) of weekly Gross Sales. Payable at the same time and in the same manner as the Royalty Fee. We have the right to increase the Marketing Fund Fee up to and including three percent (3%) of weekly Gross Sales.

Local Marketing Requirement: Currently one percent (1%) of Gross Sales. As incurred.

Software Costs: Our then-current fee (currently $250-$500). Payable each month with first Royalty Fee in each month.

Technology Fee: Our then-current fee (initially, up to $200 per month, if we implement this fee). We do not currently collect a Technology Fee but reserve the right to do so. We reserve the right to increase this fee to a maximum of $300 per month.
